item.description: Applications for the Department of Workforce Development’s (DWD) Wisconsin Fast Forward Grants are currently open to help address the state’s demand for skilled workers. Grants aim to bolster the workforce through development in two areas — Industry Sectors Worker Training Grants and Technical Education Equipment Grants. item.title: American Indian Chamber names Kevin Chesnik interim director
item.description: Photo supplied. The American Indian Chamber of Commerce Wisconsin (AICCW) on Friday announced the appointment of Kevin Chesnik as Interim Executive Director. Chesnik, 65, spent most of his career as an engineer at the state Department of Transportation, retiring as chief engineer. He is currently vice president of engineering firm Bloom Companies. An enrolled member of the Oneida Nation, Chesnik was a member of the AICCW board of directors before taking on the interim director role.

item.title: Indigenous Business Group to host Wisconsin Contractor Connection networking event series
item.description: A panel at Indigenous Biz Con. The Indigenous Business Group (IBG) will host a new networking event series with its Wisconsin Contractor Connection on May 22. The IBG is a Wisconsin-based nonprofit that drives Indigenous business and tribal economic development. Its new networking event aims to advance opportunities for both through a one stop to find everything needed to secure contracts for larger development contracts.
